headline: Lamar Jackson has thumb surgery, out 6-10 weeks

top.headline: Lamar Jackson has thumb surgery, out 6-10 weeks
top.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Friday that Jackson had surgery on the broken and dislocated thumb he hurt on the first snap of Week 8 against the Bills, and will miss 6 to 10 weeks. Jacoby Brissett, acquired in a trade with Arizona, is expected to start the rest of the season, with Tyler Huntley out for the year.

top.headline: Spurs rout Curry-less Warriors for 11th straight win
top.summary: San Antonio beat Golden State 123-85 after leading by as many as 43, and Stephon Castle set a career high with 32 points on 12-of-18 shooting. The Spurs are 11-2 and unbeaten in NBA Cup play. The Warriors, without Stephen Curry, scored a season-low 14 points in the first quarter.

top.headline: Clippers rally past Thunder; OKC drops third straight
top.summary: Darius Garland's late and-one finished a Clippers comeback after Oklahoma City led 112-106 with under three minutes left. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40, but his last shot rimmed out at the buzzer. It is the Thunder's first three-game losing streak in three seasons, with Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Cason Wallace among those out.

leagues.name: NFL
leagues.summary: Lamar Jackson out 6-10 weeks after thumb surgery; Packers rule out Parsons and Jacobs; Lock starts again for Seattle; Falcons hand out two extensions

stories.headline: Lamar Jackson has thumb surgery, out 6-10 weeks
stories.summary: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said Friday that Jackson had surgery on the broken and dislocated thumb he hurt on the first snap of Week 8 against the Bills, and will miss 6 to 10 weeks. Jacoby Brissett, acquired in a trade with Arizona, is expected to start the rest of the season, with Tyler Huntley out for the year.

stories.headline: Packers rule out Parsons and Jacobs vs. Vikings
stories.summary: Green Bay ruled out EDGE Micah Parsons (knee), RB Josh Jacobs (finger), C Sean Rhyan and TE Josh Whyle for Sunday against Minnesota. Parsons, still on the PUP list, will miss his 10th game. The Vikings are short-handed too: QB Kyler Murray, TE T.J. Hockenson, WR Jauan Jennings and LB Blake Cashman are out.

stories.headline: Drew Lock cleared to start again for Seahawks
stories.summary: Mike Macdonald said Lock (elbow, oblique) has no injury designation and will start Sunday at Las Vegas, with Sam Darnold out with rib and quad injuries. Lock is 2-0 as Seattle's starter this season. The 4-5 Raiders have allowed 30 or more points in six straight games.

stories.headline: Falcons extend Cameron Thomas and C.J. Henderson
stories.summary: Atlanta signed DE Cameron Thomas to a three-year extension through 2029 worth up to $33 million, and CB C.J. Henderson to a two-year deal worth up to $20 million. The 3-6 Falcons locked up two defenders who were headed for free agency.

stories.headline: Chiefs' Kenneth Walker questionable with groin injury
stories.summary: Kansas City listed RB Kenneth Walker III as questionable for Sunday at Atlanta after he missed Friday's practice. Elsewhere, the Texans ruled out DE Danielle Hunter and LB Azeez Al-Shaair for Cleveland, and Dallas ruled out TE Jake Ferguson against San Francisco.

leagues.name: NBA
leagues.summary: Spurs win 11th straight; Clippers rally to hand Thunder a third straight loss; Bucks fall to 1-12; Pacers edge Knicks

stories.headline: Spurs rout Curry-less Warriors for 11th straight win

Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 40, but his last shot rimmed out at the buzzer. It is the Thunder's first three-game losing streak in three seasons, with Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Cason Wallace among those out.

stories.headline: Bucks lose ninth straight, fall to 1-12
stories.summary: Orlando beat Milwaukee 107-99 behind Franz Wagner's 35 points, 9 rebounds and 12 assists. The nine-game skid matches Milwaukee's longest since 2014, and its 1-12 start is its worst in 52 years, per Sportradar.

stories.headline: Pacers hold off Knicks as 7.5-point underdogs
stories.summary: Indiana won 106-104 when Karl-Anthony Towns missed a tying jumper at the buzzer. Jalen Brunson scored 33, and Towns had 23 points and 15 rebounds for his 12th straight double-double to open the season. New York is 6-6.

stories.headline: Giannis, Adebayo score 37 apiece as Heat beat Cavs
stories.summary: Miami beat Cleveland 133-121, with Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bam Adebayo combining for 74 points. Davion Mitchell added 22 points and 17 assists, tying his career high. The Heat are 2-0 in the NBA Cup.

standouts.name: Alperen Sengun
standouts.note: His second career 40-point game handed Utah its 11th straight loss.

standouts.name: Franz Wagner
standouts.note: One rebound shy of his first career triple-double, and his fourth straight 30-point game.

standouts.name: Stephon Castle
standouts.note: A career high in San Antonio's 11th straight win.

leagues.name: NHL
leagues.summary: Predators win seventh straight in a shootout at Vegas; Rangers hand Canucks a seventh straight loss; no update on MacKinnon and Makar

stories.headline: Predators win seventh straight, top Golden Knights in shootout
stories.summary: Ryan O'Reilly scored both Nashville goals, Juuse Saros made 40 saves and Roman Josi won it in the fourth round of a 3-2 shootout win in Las Vegas. Nashville has won seven straight and four in a row on the road. Vegas' four-game winning streak ended.

stories.headline: Rangers drop Canucks to seventh straight loss
stories.summary: New York scored four straight second-period goals in a 5-1 win in Vancouver, and Glenn Gawdin, recalled from Hartford on Tuesday, scored his first two NHL goals. The Canucks are 3-17-1, the worst record in the league. The Rangers have won five of six.

stories.headline: No update on MacKinnon, Makar before Avs visit Montreal
stories.summary: Jared Bednar gave no medical update on Nathan MacKinnon or Cale Makar, who both left Thursday's overtime loss to Ottawa with lower-body injuries. Both are traveling, and Bednar said he isn't sure whether either plays Saturday. Colorado recalled forward Gavin Brindley.

stories.headline: Maple Leafs try to end home skid against Oilers
stories.summary: Toronto has lost five straight regulation games at home, its longest such skid since 1990-91. The Leafs are 1-7-0 in their last eight and 8-11-2 overall, and Jim Hiller hadn't named a starting goalie for Saturday.

stories.headline: Wild's Faber could make season debut Saturday
stories.summary: John Hynes said Brock Faber could debut Saturday in Boston but it isn't guaranteed. Faber fractured his skull in a Sept. 25 preseason game. Minnesota is 14-3-4 and hasn't lost in regulation since Oct. 22.

standouts.name: Juuse Saros
standouts.note: Also stopped three of four shootout attempts, including Jack Eichel's, for Nashville's seventh straight win.

standouts.name: Glenn Gawdin
standouts.note: His first two NHL goals, days after a recall from Hartford.

standouts.name: Ryan O'Reilly
standouts.note: Scored both Nashville goals in regulation to force the shootout.

leagues.name: MLB
leagues.summary: Offseason · Mets seen as Skubal favorites; Red Sox agree with Jake Bauers

stories.headline: Mets seen as favorites for Skubal after GM meetings
stories.summary: ESPN reports the Mets left the GM meetings as the industry favorites for free-agent ace Tarik Skubal. The Blue Jays, Padres and Dodgers are also meeting with him; the Cubs are not bidding. The CBA expires Dec. 1, and a lockout could follow.

stories.headline: Rays could shop DeLuca, McClanahan and Pepiot
stories.summary: The Athletic reports Tampa Bay could make center fielder Jonny DeLuca available, with Shane McClanahan and Ryan Pepiot also possible trade candidates. The Rays intend to keep Drew Rasmussen after exercising his $20 million 2027 option.

stories.headline: Cubs need to rebuild their whole rotation
stories.summary: All five of the Cubs' 2026 starters are free agents: Shota Imanaga, Matthew Boyd, David Peterson, Kevin Gausman and Clay Holmes. Chicago has been linked to Michael King, Freddy Peralta and Japanese right-hander Kaima Taira, among others.

moves.text: Red Sox agree with 1B Jake Bauers on a four-year, $58M deal (reported, not yet official)
Angels avoid arbitration with C Tyler Heineman (1 year, $1.2375M); re-sign LHP Sammy Peralta to a minor league deal
Nationals release RHP Kyle Nicolas
